title: AI-assisted acoustic monitoring for adaptive urban wildlife planning
description: A curated, support-aware workflow linking AI-assisted passive acoustic monitoring, life-history-informed modelling, spatial validation and adaptive monitoring design for Asian Koel acoustic activity in Shenzhen.
